sql: SELECT DISTINCT buyer.id AS number, buyer.name FROM customer buyer LEFT JOIN orders purchase ON purchase.customer_id = buyer.id WHERE purchase.status = 'paid' ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT DISTINCT "Buyer".id AS "select", UPPER("Buyer".name) AS "Name" FROM customer "Buyer" JOIN orders "Purchase" ON "Purchase".customer_id = "Buyer".id ORDER BY "select"
SELECT DISTINCT MOD(c.id, 2) AS bucket FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id OR o.customer_id = c.id + 1
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(c.name, 'missing') AS name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
SELECT customer_id + 1 AS next_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id + 1 HAVING customer_id + 1 > 2 AND COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 AND (customer_id IS NULL OR customer_id < 3)
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING customer_id IS NULL OR COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT c.id, o.id AS order_id FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' OR o.id IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT c.id, COALESCE(o.status, 'missing') AS status FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders HAVING FALSE
SELECT name FROM customer WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status IS NULL)
